context: Your master list is the cards you retire with reason pulled. Your store already has 10 Riftbound cards retired as pulled. If they count, they show as collected on day one.

options.gain: Nothing new to learn; one press means one thing.
options.how: Every pulled retirement is a master-set card, old ones included.
options.label: Yes, count them
options.lose: Any of the 10 pulled for another reason shows as collected.

options.gain: Pulled for other reasons stays separate.
options.how: Add a fifth retire reason, such as master set. Only that reason counts.
options.label: Add a master-set reason
options.lose: One more reason to pick at each retire; the 10 old ones do not count.

ref: PR 965, draft master-set spec; D26, retired is a terminal card state
title: Do cards already retired as pulled count toward your master set?
why: Fewest new parts. You can undo any of the 10 that should not count.
